faqs.a:
To promote the public health, safety and welfare, and economic well-being of the city
               and to avoid and prevent public nuisance, the city council hereby finds and declares
               that it is in the best interests of the city to adopt procedures to evaluate the environmental
               condition of certain property within the city, to be annexed to the city, or to be
               acquired by the city and to provide remediation as set forth therein.
(Code 1981, § 25-81; Ord. No. 3009, § 1, 10-4-1993)
